# Right of Way

> HAZWOPER training for pipeline and utility emergency responders: the 40-hour utility/pipeline course, incident command, refresher training and spill response.

Right of Way (https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Incident Command (q), Refresher with Incident Command, Gas Detection training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Command for HAZWOPER emergency response. Enroll: https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [8 Hour HAZWOPER and Incident Command Refresher Training](https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training): $249.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(8). The annual refresher with ICS. Enroll: https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training?buy=574
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Monitoring at gas releases. Enroll: https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056

## Guides

- [First actions at a pipeline release](https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/guides/pipeline-release-first-actions): Life safety, ignition sources and isolation, in that order.
- [Working with the fire department at a utility incident](https://pipeline.hazwoperosha.us/guides/working-with-the-fire-department): Unified command makes the operator and responders one team.
